content.text:
All checks (tests, typecheck, lint, format) pass.

Fixed the bug in `src/queries/posts/post-save-mutation.ts`: the save-draft mutation only wrote the returned post into the single-post cache, never touching the site's post-list cache, so the list page kept showing the old title/timestamp until something else (e.g. a publish) invalidated it. It now also patches the matching entry in the post-list cache with the saved data, mirroring the pattern already used for the detail query rather than adding a network round-trip via `invalidateQueries`. Added `src/queries/posts/post-save-mutation.test.ts` covering both the patch and the case where the list hasn't been fetched yet.

Fixed the bug in `src/queries/posts/post-save-mutation.ts`: the save-draft mutation only wrote the returned post into the single-post cache, never touching the site's post-list cache, so the list page kept showing the old title/timestamp until something else (e.g. a publish) invalidated it. It now also patches the matching entry in the post-list cache with the saved data, mirroring the pattern already used for the detail query rather than adding a network round-trip via `invalidateQueries`. Added `src/queries/posts/post-save-mutation.test.ts` covering both the patch and the case where the list hasn't been fetched yet.
